name: 06-dawn-dip-b4a54f0
description: cam-wyze-pan basement dawn: resting night-pipeline gain a stable 10856 for hours, dawn dips it to ~820 - under the adaptive trigger - while the day pipeline still reads a railed 8192 (genuinely dark behind the closed IR-cut). Pre-fix the direct adaptive night->day switch fired after just the 5s hysteresis on every dawn fluctuation, found darkness, reverted, and repeated: 5 audible IR-cut pairs in one morning, spaced too far apart for the oscillation breaker. Post-fix night->day is probe-mediated: the brightening hold lets the smoother converge to the dip floor, ONE probe pair fires, its failure latches the ratchet at the floor (~830, bar ~500) so the same dip is unrepeatable, and the camera stays night.
